description: This file contains a library of functions related to 'git-bundle' operations, including manipulating bundle files, converting bundles to pack data, and checking the object count within a bundle.

methods.name: convert_bundle_to_pack
methods.description: Reads a bundle file, skips the header, and outputs the pack data.

methods.name: test_bundle_object_count
methods.description: Checks the object count in a bundle file, optionally handling thin packs.
